title: Efficient construction of time-invariant process tensors for simulating high-dimensional non-Markovian open quantum systems
summary: Numerical methods for obtaining exact dynamics of non-Markovian open quantum systems are mostly limited to either small systems or to short-time evolution only. Here, we propose a new algorithm for computing process tensors--matrix product operator (MPO) representations that capture the environment influence--which achieves greatly enhanced computational scalings with system size, while maintaining linear scaling with simulation length.
